notes.title: Version 2.0.5 - crash + UI bug fix
notes.content:
Fixed a UI bug + crash where opening the pause menu made the fastforward button stop working.

Keep reporting any crashes you hit and we'll keep trying to fix them!
- Darzington ✨

notes.content: Fixed a crash in the [i]Cult of the Dark One[/i] scenario when two heroes come to warn you about your performance on the same night. Thanks to the player who reported it! o7

notes.title: Quest Giver 2.0.3 - Optional Crash Reporting
notes.content:
Hey, I've added a simple window that displays a crash report, with a button that let's you send it to me! Should be useful if there are any Quest Giver bugs still lingering :P 
- Zal

notes.title: Version 1.2.2: Fancy text & minor bug fixes
notes.content:
Hey folks, just some quick bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed several UI input bugs (including one submitted by [i]TheChronicleHunter[/i], thanks!)
[*] Fixed an incorrect note in one of the scenario songs
[*] Fixed an unlikely but devastating crash in the music engine
[/list]
Plus we've dotted some [b]cool[/b] text effects around the game for special dialogue:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44697663/4b8724c282964b77d9c21d920fb8d8bca21e860b.gif[/img]

That's it for now, but we've got something fun coming down the pipeline, to be announced soon!

notes.title: Version 1.2: SFX, QoL, and a Discord Server!
notes.content:
We’ve just launched our [url=https://discord.gg/WjcNdm5dsn]Discord server[/url]! Hop in to chat about Quest Giver and get a sneak peak at our next project 🤫

Version 1.2 includes:
[list]
[*] New sound effects, especially during the end of day results
[*] Hints for various input modes when the game is first launched
[*] Mouse QoL: use the scroll wheel when viewing heroes or quests to quickly change between them
[*] New office art & store page art
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697663/8cbe44f85581ce49f4bde19c7e0b21247e5482a1.png[/img]

💖 Thanks for reading!
- Darz & Zal

notes.title: Version 1.1.1: Small clarity update + bug & crash fixes
notes.content:
There's a nice little update for all you NPCs today:
[list]
[*] Set the default font to CURVY for new players (since people find it easier to read, and by golly QG is a readin' game)
[*] Fixed a crash in [i]The World Needs a Hero[/i] if Krol is killed early and the goblin quest is ignored, thanks to [b]Kerolink[/b] for finding and reporting it! ːsteamthumbsupː
[*] Fixed some French and English typos
[*] Added a more noticeable scroll for important quest results:
[/list][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44697663/92557eda6b75c937fe6776521485bfce611b06a9.png[/img]

In other news: we're up to nearly [b]17 000 global quests succeeded[/b], well done everyone!

See you at the next update 💖
-Darzington & Zalinius
